description: This file contains unit tests for the GstProtectionMetadataWrapper class, testing its methods for adding, retrieving, and removing protection metadata from GstBuffer objects. It uses Google Test framework and mocks GstWrapper interactions.

classes.name: RialtoProtectionMetadataTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing GstProtectionMetadataWrapper functionalities.

methods.name: addProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Test for adding protection metadata to a GstBuffer.

methods.name: getProtectionMetadataDataSuccess
methods.description: Test for successfully retrieving protection metadata data from a GstBuffer.

methods.name: getProtectionMetadataDataNoMeta
methods.description: Test for retrieving protection metadata data when no metadata is present.

methods.name: removeProtectionMetadataSuccess
methods.description: Test for successfully removing protection metadata from a GstBuffer.

methods.name: removeProtectionMetadataFail
methods.description: Test for failure to remove protection metadata when removal returns false.

methods.name: removeProtectionMetadataNoMeta
methods.description: Test for attempting to remove protection metadata when no metadata exists.
